Exact-match rate 0.047 is slightly above every category's range, so it does not discriminate. Refusals dropped is 3 of 64, which fits fine-tuned (0 – 5) and not quantized (0 – 1). Stage directions are only 3.1% and the median divergence is not 0, so system-prompted is unlikely. Base is ruled out because the replies differ.
